Sofia (CS): Final preflight for Orchid dedicated bring-up — TOMORROW 02:30 UTC. Need owners for: quota confirmation, canary run, autoscale tuning, and customer comms.

Derek (Infra): Ill own reservation + warmup. Pool: pool-orchid-02, template=reserved-a100v4-flex, slots=6, spare=2. Will create reservation and attach manifest.

Leo (SE): Ill run canary and staged load. Plan: 5% traffic 10m -> 25% 20m -> full. Require canary key + KMS unseal window 02:15-02:40 UTC.

Maya (SRE): Autoscale baseline: min=2, target_util=60%, max=10, scale_up_cd=90s, scale_down_cd=240s. Suggest enabling queue_length signal and p95 alert at 320ms.

Sofia (CS): Customer requested a one-off warmup credit and a short post-run feedback call. Ill log renewal notes (health=watch). Who will post live updates to the customer channel?

Derek (Infra): Reservation + warmup commands:

Derek (Infra): ```
redwoodctl reserve create --pool pool-orchid-02 --slots 6 --duration 4h --note "orchid-onramp"
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool pool-orchid-02 --profile cache-warm --concurrency 4
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled job id=6200000000-load for 2026-07-15T02:30:00Z  logs will post to this thread.

Leo (SE): Smoke curl (will replace token at run):

Leo (SE): ```
curl -s -X POST https://orchid.api/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer CANARY_TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"input":"smoke"}'
```

Maya (SRE): Fallback plan: if error_rate > 1% for 2m or p95 > 400ms -> shift up to 30% to hosted-quantized fallback and pause ramp. Add a quick rollback script in the runbook.

Sofia (CS): Thanks. Quick checklist pre-run: 1) KMS unseal window (Derek) 2) Canary key issued (Leo) 3) Reservation created (Derek) 4) Runbook + rollback present (Maya) 5) Billing buffer noted (Sofia). Ill post the customer blurb; please DM if blocked. :white_check_mark:
